s: Shello lehapsiq bepiyyutin ubo b' seipim: mah shennohagin bimqomot harbeh lomar piyyutim bebirkot qeriat shema — yesh omerim shekkol mi sheepshar lo lebattel hamminhag shello al yede hammachaloqet yebattel, lepi shehappiyyutim sheenan meinyan habberaka chashubin hepseq gamur, vaapillu im hem meinyan habberaka en lomar shehu kemaarik habberaka umosip bah, shehare ameru: maqom sheameru leqatztzer eno rashshay lehaarik, vekol hamshanneh mimmatbea shettabeu chakamim babberakot eno ella toeh. Veod shehi sibba lehapsiq bidbarim betelim keshehashsheliach tzibbur omer happiyyut. Veyesh omerim sheen issur baddabar, shezzeh sheameru: bemaqom sheameru leqatztzer eno rashshay lehaarik — lo ameru ella bibrakot arukkot sheppotechot be"baruk" vechotemot be"baruk" eno rashshay leqatztzer, shello liptoach be"baruk" o shello lachtom, veim shinna — hare zeh meshanneh mimmatbea shettabeu chakamim bibrakot velo yatza yede chobato, abal shear nussach habberaka lo natenu bo chakamim shiur sheyyomar kak vekak millot lo pachot velo yoter, sheim ken haya lahem letaqqen nussach kol beraka bemilot menuyot, vezeh lo matzinu beshum maqom, velo hizkiru ella hammillot sheyyesh haqpada bahen lebad, kegon yetziat mitzrayim umalkut uqeriat yam sup umakkat bekorot be"emet veyatztzib", uberit vetora bebirkat haaretz, vekayyotze bahen, abal shear hannussach shello hizkiru sheyyesh haqpada bo — eno meakkeb kelal im shinna oto vaamaro bilshon acher, o apillu lo amaro kelal. Vehu haddin im hosip veheerik bo, apillu hattosapot merubbeh al haiqqar, ukemo shehittiru lehosip bebirkat hattepilla meen kol beraka uberaka ukemo sheyyitbaer besiman qy"t. Veken nohagin bimdinot ellu. Vehameqil veeno omeram — lo hipsid. Umikkol maqom lo yaasoq beshum dabar, vaapillu bedibre tora asur lehapsiq laasoq kol zeman shehatztzibbur omerim piyyutim, kol shekken ledabber shum sicha betela. Umikkol maqom mi shellomed al yede hirhur sheroeh basseper umeharher — en bazeh issur kelal, shehirhur eno kedibbur veeno chashub hepseq. Ella sheyyesh lachush lahamon am sheal yiru min hallomed basseper veyapsiqu gam ken bidbarim acherim, al ken en laadam liprosh atzmo mehatztzibbur bimqom shennahagu leomram veyomar otam immahem. Ubepesach (shehachazzanim maarikin harbeh beniggunim) — mutab lomar happiyyut qodem sheyyatchil habberaka, sheharob hu shello meen habberaka, vechashub hepseq beemtza habberaka (kesheshshohin bo kede ligmor et kullah). Vekol zeh betzibbur, abal hammitpalel beyachid en lo lomar shum piyyut bebirkat qeriat shema, apillu qodem shemmatchil habberaka, shehare asur lehapsiq ben "yishtabbach" le"yotzer". Vaapillu betzibbur, im shakach lomar happiyyut ad sheggamar habberaka — asur leomro, shekkesheomero beemtza habberaka taam hahetter hu mishshum shehu meen habberaka, abal ben beraka libraka — asur lehapsiq:

Vekol zeh bebirkat qeriat shema, abal bitpillat y"ch en happiyyutim chashubim hepseq, shehare muttar lehosip meen kol beraka uberaka. Vaapillu beg' — yesh mattirin lomar piyyutim, hoil vehen tzorke rabbim kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qy"b. Veken rabbi elazar haqqalir shehaya meeretz yisrael miqqiryat seper, ubeyamayv hayu meqaddeshim al pi hareiyya, shehare lo tiqqen shum qrvb"tz leyom sheni vetanna hu, vehu tiqqen qrvb"tz leg' rishonot. Veyesh nohagin shello lomar shum piyyut apillu shello bebirkat qeriat shema, ella mah shessidderu harishonim, kegon hqlyr"y shetiqqenu al derek haemet. Omnam hamminhagim shennahagu beshorshe hattepilla en leshannot mimminhag abotayv, ki y"b shearim bashshamayim keneged y"b shebatim, vekol shebet yesh lo shaar uminhag bipne atzmo, lebad mah shennizkar baggemara (o bedibre happoseqim shellamedu dibrehem mehaggemara) hu shaveh lakkol:
